ns0:svg.ns0:title: AH and Bessel matrix recurrence at even ranks through 64
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Five panels fix L at 16, 24, 32, 48, and 64. N values are 8, 16, 24, 32, 36, 48, 64. Logarithmic axes show cold-process times in seconds. Markers are medians of three fresh processes, and whiskers show their observed minimum and maximum. Each process includes initialization and four exact queries. Circles and connecting lines describe the existing serial grid batch. Squares at N=36 describe a separate parallel batch and are not connected to the serial observations. The CSV retains all observations and the additional low-rank anchors L=4 and L=8.
